claims: NASA’s Artemis II launched successfully on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II mission is currently underway.
Astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen are aboard the Orion spacecraft.
The Orion spacecraft is orbiting the Earth before traveling to the Moon.
The crew is performing systems checks in orbit before the translunar injection burn to head toward the moon.
Artemis II is the first crewed Moon mission since 1972.
Artemis II serves as a test flight for future Artemis landings.
The crew will travel around the Moon and return to Earth in about 10 days.
